clue.text: Hear fresh bloody army, retreating, is captured ——useless!

indicators.note: is captured means the reversed army is held inside the word for bloody

explanation.surface: An exasperated cry that a raw, battered army in retreat has been taken prisoner and is now useless.

explanation.definitionFit: Nugatory is a formal word for something of no value or force, so it is a synonym of useless.
